result.citation: L.A. Mun. Code (section not stated) (Ord. No. 188481; Ord. No. 188482)
result.citation_basis: Ord. No. 188481 and Ord. No. 188482, effective 2/11/2025: D043 (LAHD Relocation Assistance Bulletin B); no document states the L.A. Mun. Code section that codifies the RPO
result.note: I dropped LAMC § 165.03.I(1) and §§ 151.22-151.28 because they are the JCO and Ellis Act filing provisions, not the RPO relocation rule; I put the code name first with '(section not stated)' because no document gives the RPO's code section; and I removed the 'Resident Protections Ordinance' nickname because only the LAHD bulletin uses it, not the ordinance text.
